thread:
maria: Quick sync — PR ready for review: context-trim + 429 fallback UX migration. Changes span the troubleshooting guide, SDK snippets (JS/Python), and a couple of console link updates. Preview: https://staging.redwood/docs/preview/ctx-trim-429

sam: taking a look now. does this change the recommended behavior for partial outputs when ctx trim occurs?

maria: Yes. Recommendation: prefer graceful partial outputs + attempt a quick retry with a trimmed prompt window, then fall back to a compatible, lower-capacity model. Docs include a flow chart.

jen: Can you paste the JS snippet here so I can run a quick smoke on staging?

kevin: Heads-up — SDK v2 parameter names differ. If your snippet uses `max_context` we should map it to the new `context_limit`/`trim_strategy` pair. I'll handle patching.

maria: JS snippet (short):
```js
// auto trim + fallback example
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-large',
  prompt: trimPrompt(original, {strategy: 'suffix', maxTokens: 1000}),
  retry_policy: {type: 'exponential', max_retries: 3},
  fallback: {model: 'redwood-medium'}
});
```

maria: Python quick example too:
```py
# graceful partial output + 429 fallback
resp = client.generate(
  model='redwood-large',
  prompt=trim_prompt(text, strategy='prefix', max_tokens=1000),
  retry_policy={'type': 'exp', 'max_retries': 3},
  fallback={'model': 'redwood-medium'}
)
```

docs-bot: New preview page created: https://staging.docs.redwood/tickets/9123 — comments are open. Please run docs lint before merge.

luca: :eyes: from product — do we also need a console alert for "context trimmed" events so users understand partial outputs?

sam: we already emit a `context_trim` metric and `partial_output=true` flag in the response envelope. Console should surface both (token counts + reason). I have a branch adding token-counts to traces.

maria: ACTIONS: @kevin update SDK snippet format & run lint; @sam add metric names and an example response JSON; @jen smoke test the JS example on staging; I'll iterate on the preview doc and add an appendix for manual vs automatic fallback patterns.

kevin: Roger. I'll update SDK examples and open a small PR. ETA EOD.

jen: Quick question — the 429 handling example uses exp backoff until N tries then switches to fallback-model. Should we keep both automatic fallback (recommended) and a manual code path (optional)?

maria: Include both. Auto fallback is the recommended default; manual sample in appendix for teams that want explicit control.

sam: FYI runtime v1.8 renames `retry_strategy` -> `fallback_policy`. Docs need a short mapping note so users on older runtime don't get confused.

maria: Good catch — added a mapping table in the PR diff and a short compatibility note.

kevin: Pushed SDK snippet fix: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/789 — updated arg names and added example tests.

maria: Updated preview with SDK link. PTAL. If no objections I'll merge tomorrow morning and request a backport for legacy docs.

luca: :thumbsup: product ok with merge.

docs-bot: Reminder: run `make docs-check` before merging. CI: https://ci.redwood/builds/4567

maria: Running CI now. Thanks all — will post final merge note here when green.
